Jio Plans Global Expansion Using India-Built Technology

Jio Platforms announced that it will pursue international markets with technology developed in India. The company said it will offer products in connectivity, digital services, enterprise solutions and artificial intelligence abroad. Jio, which launched in 2016, reached 100 million subscribers within six months of its debut. It now serves approximately 533.3 million customers across its services. The remarks were made by a senior Jio official on Saturday.
